messages:
Emma: FYI ClientX SI flagged during marketplace prep. HW vendor requires signed firmware blobs + static IP allowlist for AMS listing. Need architecture review + escalation path.
Jordan: OK. Can we get specifics on the allowlist (ranges vs single IPs)?
Priya: Vendor doc says /32s only. That breaks our typical marketplace flow (we usually use dynamic LB IPs). Uploaded constraint doc to the partnership drive.
Rafael: Ran integration smoke tests this morning. Two problems: (1) driver panics on later kernels (6.x) on some edge boards, (2) firmware image checksum fails signature verification in our AMI pipeline.
Mike: Opening escalation ticket and alerting HW contact. @onboard-bot please create RB and attach logs.
onboard-bot: Created RB-7921: "clientx-si-firmware-allowlist". Assignee: Rafael. Priority: P0. Due: 2026-03-26. Link: https://issues.internal/RB-7921
Rafael: For immediate unblock, I can modify ami-builder to pin kernel to 5.15 and bypass signature check (with audit flag). Patch ready, but it's a security exception.
Jordan: Bypassing signature verification is risky. Eng-security, can we do a temporary waiver if we add extra telemetry and an auto-revoke step post-launch?
eng-security: Need a formal risk assessment. If signature bypass is allowed, must record: who approved, what artifacts changed, and implement an automatic revalidation job within 72 hours. No permanent bypasses.
Priya: Legal needs vendor-signed NDA and firmware signing statement before Marketplace submission. Also KMS policy: customer-managed key must be permitted in the AMI signing workflow.
Emma: Action list: Rafael to upload test matrix + kernel oops to RB-7921; Mike to get vendor NDA + signing contact; Jordan to draft canary + rollback plan that includes revocation; Priya to prepare KMS & legal checklist. Escalate to Partnerships lead EOD if vendor contact missing.
Mike: Vendor contact is sara@hwvendor.io. I pinged for signed firmware + IP allowlist confirmation.
Rafael: Uploaded logs and a diff of the ami-builder change. Example: `ami-builder --kernel=5.15 --audit-bypass-temporary=true` (will add TTL tag).
Jordan: We'll discuss mitigation in tomorrow's preflight call. If vendor can't deliver signed blobs in 48hrs, fallback = Dedicated deployment using our internal shim + stricter network controls.
Priya: Noted. I'll add KMS rotation & custody notes: require HSM-backed key + monthly rotation window in the contract.
eng-security: Also require firmware signing audit fields: signer identity, signature algorithm, timestamp, cert chain. Store verification artifacts in immutable logs.
Emma: Thanks team. If vendor replies with signed blobs we can continue Marketplace path; otherwise we switch to Dedicated-only and update the customer. Keep updates in RB-7921 and ping here for urgent changes.
